# AgileToolHub

AgileToolHub provides free browser-based Agile and Scrum tools, templates, and guides for software teams. Most tools require no login and no paid subscription.

## Tool directory

- Planning Poker: real-time team story point estimation with simultaneous Fibonacci votes. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/planning-poker
- Story Point Calculator: quick story point recommendation from effort, complexity, uncertainty, risk, and dependencies. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/story-point-calculator
- User Story Generator: creates a Jira-ready user story from a feature idea. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/user-story-generator
- Acceptance Criteria Generator: creates Given/When/Then or checklist acceptance criteria. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/acceptance-criteria-generator
- Bug Report to Jira Ticket Converter: turns rough bug notes into a structured Jira ticket. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/bug-report-to-jira-ticket-converter
- Sprint Capacity Calculator: estimates realistic sprint commitment from team availability and velocity. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/sprint-capacity-calculator
- Daily Standup Generator: turns rough notes into a Yesterday/Today/Blockers update. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/daily-standup-generator
- Retrospective Board: shared live board for feedback, improvements, and action items. https://agiletoolhub.com/tools/retro-board

## High-value guides

- Story Points Explained: https://agiletoolhub.com/docs/story-points-explained

- How to Write Acceptance Criteria: https://agiletoolhub.com/guides/how-to-write-acceptance-criteria

## Structured directory

For tool purposes, inputs, outputs, and workflow selection, see https://agiletoolhub.com/ai-tools

## Agent API

Machine-readable tool manifest: https://agiletoolhub.com/api/agent/tools
- Story point estimator: POST https://agiletoolhub.com/api/agent/story-point
- Sprint capacity calculator: POST https://agiletoolhub.com/api/agent/sprint-capacity
- User story generator: POST https://agiletoolhub.com/api/agent/user-story
- Acceptance criteria generator: POST https://agiletoolhub.com/api/agent/acceptance-criteria
- OpenAPI specification: https://agiletoolhub.com/openapi.json
- Agent API documentation: https://agiletoolhub.com/docs/ai-agent-tools

All agent endpoints are free, require no API key, accept JSON, and return deterministic JSON/Markdown results. Human review remains recommended for product decisions and sprint commitments.
